title: PageLedger Review Decisions File
description: The JSON form of a review sheet, which the review view downloads as review.json and review --apply reads. bindings is the sheet's binding (see review-sheet-binding.schema.json); rows hold only the pages with a decision. A row's text is a corrected page, recorded exactly after CRLF and lone CR are made LF.

decision.description: A review sheet decision (accept, blank, illustration, handwriting, unreadable, source_defect, use:ATTEMPT, correct:FILE), or correct with the corrected text in text.

text.description: The corrected text, with decision correct.

from.description: With a correct decision: the attempt whose own reading the correction starts from. Absent or empty: the page's selected text.
